digest.component_or_area: ticket tracker git store reclamation and epoch enforcement
propositions: A force-push rewrite of the tickets branch must occur only when all writers are quiesced: workflows disabled, review bot in_flight==0, Gerrit has no open LLM-unapplied patchsets, and operator confirms zero active sessions and stopped MCP servers

The pre-publication correctness assertions must verify tree identity, commit/merge counts unchanged, identity summary identical ignoring rewritten SHAs, and non-resurrection of old-tip ancestry before any force-with-lease push

After publication, the first review-bot post-window write (the enforce_since re-pin Gerrit vote) must confirm non-resurrection and measure size-pack growth < 1 MB, with old-tip ancestry definitively false across default clones

The explicitly refreshed host rebar runtime and deployed review-bot must each demonstrate epoch-mismatch refusal in separate probes before publication, replacing time-based proxies with direct evidence

Post-window reconciliation must run without divergence: reconciler/canary workflows re-enabled, signed CLI substitute dry/live/convergence passes recorded if Actions outage occurs, state persisted, and final fsck clean with exactly four intentional resolved-fork audit records
The landed identity.enforce_since key must equal the commit-mapped post-rewrite SHA, with require_authenticated=false preventing CI deadlock and normal Gerrit LLM-Review/Verified/Submit process
